sourceSemantics.staking: Inherited deposit/mint transfer initialized USN from caller then mint shares to receiver. OZ virtual assets/shares conversion offset 0; totalAssets uses underlying balanceOf. Deposit/redeem floor, mint/withdraw ceil. sUSN decimals overridden to 18.
sourceSemantics.exits: owner must equal msg.sender. Non-whitelisted exit receiver equals stored withdrawalHandler; fixed handler createWithdrawalRequest(msg.sender,assets) precedes parent share burn/USN transfer. Whitelisted exit receiver must differ from handler. No arbitrary caller target or opaque execution data. Request settlement is a separate unadmitted handler surface.
sourceSemantics.pause: _update checks whenNotPaused and blacklist[from]/blacklist[to]. Preview/max functions do not incorporate all these checks.
sourceSemantics.scope: No USN primary mint/redeem, bridge transport/message callbacks, admin methods or handler settlement added. Ordinary source calls have no slippage/deadline bounds. Upgrades and mutable dependencies remain authoritative.

selectedFunctions.label: Noon sUSN deposit
warnings: Upgradeable Ethereum sUSN proxy: ABI bound to source-service-reported implementation 0xeF2eA4250B7CE4D0aA9Ca70607ECeF278C6EAB15 on 2026-10-22, not a fresh runtime/storage identity attestation. Admin can upgrade, pause, blacklist, whitelist and replace the withdrawal handler.

Assets are USN, not USDC. Deposit/mint consume caller USN allowance and issue rate-dependent sUSN shares. No caller-set minimum output, maximum input or deadline; floor rounding can produce zero shares/assets for small positive amounts. Rebases and donations affect conversion.

Withdraw/redeem require owner == msg.sender; share allowances do not enable delegated exits. Non-whitelisted callers MUST use the configured withdrawal handler as receiver, creating a withdrawal request before burning shares and transferring USN to that handler, not immediate payment to the user. Whitelisted callers must NOT use that handler as receiver. Handler configuration and settlement are not attested; handler claim/withdrawal is not admitted by these four functions.

Pause and blacklist checks apply to share mint/burn/transfer. All four functions are nonpayable and require zero native value; balances, allowances, receiver selection and independent execution controls remain authoritative.

Official sUSN terms impose jurisdiction, sanctions and KYC/AML eligibility, permit emergency withdrawal freezes and proportional losses. Catalog inclusion does not establish legal eligibility, backing, liquidity, yield, complete workflows, financial safety or successful execution and does not grant API-key authority.
